Class AccountController

java.lang.Object
app.account.AccountController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api") public class AccountController extends Object
REST endpoints for the authenticated caller's accounts and holdings. All endpoints filter data by the authenticated user's UUID from the token's sub claim. Users can only view and modify their own accounts.

    • getAccount

      @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}") public AccountResponse getAccount(@PathVariable Integer accountId, @AuthenticationPrincipal org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt jwt)
      Returns a specific account if it belongs to the authenticated caller.
      Parameters:
      accountId - the account ID
      jwt - the verified access token
      Returns:
      the account details
      Throws:
      AccountNotFoundException - if the account does not exist
      ForbiddenException - if the account is owned by a different user

    • listHoldings

      @GetMapping("/accounts/{accountId}/holdings") public List<HoldingResponse> listHoldings(@PathVariable Integer accountId, @AuthenticationPrincipal org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt jwt)
      Returns all holdings for a specific account if it belongs to the authenticated caller.

      @PutMapping("/me/accounts/{accountId}") public AccountResponse updateAccount(@PathVariable Integer accountId, @RequestBody UpdateAccountNameRequest request, @AuthenticationPrincipal org.springframework.security.oauth2.jwt.Jwt jwt)
